name: Neural Radiance Distribution Field
aliases: Inverse Volume Rendering with Radiance Fields
definition: A new implicit representation for 3D scenes that outputs radiance distribution along rays, combining the single-forwarding speed of NeLF with the small network size of NeRF.
summary: Neural Radiance Distribution Field is a novel view synthesis method that maps camera rays directly to parametric radiance distributions for real-time rendering with low memory cost.
